notes.subject: Tingting stret
notes.rationale: Imperative summons addressed to the senseless among the people

notes.subject: yu
notes.rationale: Direct second-person address to the brutish and foolish

notes.subject: ol man olgeta i no gat tingting
notes.rationale: בערים literally 'burnt/beast-like' (בער), brutish; rendered descriptively since Tok Pisin lacks one word

translation: Tingting stret, ol man olgeta i no gat tingting long ol lain, na ol man no gat tingting — klia o, long wanem taim bai yu save tingting stret?

tokens.gloss: ol man olgeta i no gat tingting
na ol man no gat tingting
